High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore

sentences.text:
BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE PRANAY VERMA  ON THE 9 th OF JULY, 2024  WRIT PETITION No. 18310 of 2024  M/S. T. R. TREHAN THROUGH ITS DIRECTOR SHRI ANIL  SALHOTRA  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 (BY SHRI SHEKHAR SHARMA, LEARNED COUNSEL FOR THE  PETITIONER)
 (BY SHRI KOUSTUBH PATHAK - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 ORDER

By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs:
(i) This Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to call for the records from the respondents of their impugned inaction and of the representations submitted by the petitioner.
(ii) This Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent to release the awarded amount to the tune of Rs.2,88,45,510/-
in terms of the provisions of MP Land Acquisition Act, 2013.

(iii) This Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow any other relief which this Hon'ble Court deems just and proper in the view of aforesaid facts and grounds may kindly be allowed in favour of the petitioner.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that certain lands of the petitioner were acquired by the respondents under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
An award was eventually passed on 16.10.2023 wherein the petitioner was held entitled for award of a sum of compensation as 2 M/S. T. R. Trehan Through Its Director ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29609087/
1 WP-18310-2024 stated therein.

entities.text: S. T. R. Trehan Through Its Director ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thereafter, the petitioner has repeatedly been approaching the respondents for payment of the awarded amount.
It is submitted that the amount of award has been illegally withheld from the petitioner which deserves to be directed to be paid to him.
3. Learned counsel for the respondents/State has submitted that appropriate action in the matter as warranted under the law would be taken.

4. In the aforesaid facts of the case, it is directed that the amount of compensation which has been determined under the award dated 16.10.2023 [Annexure P/1] be paid to the petitioner by the respondents along with the statutory interest within a period of two months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order in case there is no legal impediment for the same.
In case the respondents are of any opinion whatsoever that the amount is not to be paid to the petitioner, then a reasoned and a speaking order in that regard be passed.
5. With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed off.

(PRANAY VERMA) JUDGE jyoti M/S. T. R. Trehan Through Its Director ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29609087/
